app.name: Komon Portal
app.tagline: Every document on the right shelf.
app.lead: Documents from your labour and social security office arrive here, and you can send payroll material back the same way.

common.individualNumberNotice: Do not upload documents that contain an Individual Number (My Number).

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.privacy: Use the Google account you were approved with. Only your Google account ID and display name are kept. Your email address is not requested or stored.
signIn.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured on this installation.
signIn.approvalNote: After you use an invitation, the office checks your display name and approves your access. Nothing is visible until then.
signIn.developmentNote: Development environment: sign in as a ready-made test user. These buttons do not exist in production.

redeem.title: Use an invitation
redeem.lead: The office gave you a one-time link. It works once and expires 72 hours after it was issued.
redeem.signInFirst: Sign in with Google first. You will come back to this page.
redeem.turnstileMissing: The human check is not configured on this installation, so this form cannot be used.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.lead: Enter the setup token that was set when this portal was deployed. The first person who does so becomes the Owner of the office.
setup.closed: Setup is finished. An Owner already exists, or no setup token is configured.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.lead: Your invitation was used as {name}. The office will check this name and approve your access.
pending.note: Nothing is visible until you are approved. If you used the link by mistake, you can simply sign out.

noAccess.title: No access yet
noAccess.lead: You are signed in, but this account has not been invited. Ask your office for an invitation link.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

network_error._: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

bad_response._: The server sent an answer that could not be read.

internal_error._: The server failed to handle the request. Try again later.

unauthenticated._: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

forbidden._: You are not allowed to do this.

bad_origin._: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.

bad_csrf._: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.

human_check_failed._: The human check did not pass. Try it again.

not_configured._: This feature is not configured on this installation.
not_configured.turnstile: The human check is not configured on this installation.
not_configured.google: Google sign-in is not configured on this installation.

sign_in_failed._: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.

conflict._: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
conflict.stale: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
conflict.duplicate_content: This client already holds a document with the same content.
conflict.client_code_taken: This client code is already in use.
conflict.short_code_taken: This short code is already in use.
conflict.arrival_number_taken: This arrival number already belongs to another case.

invalid_input._: Some of the input is not valid.
invalid_input.invitation: This invitation cannot be used. It may have expired, been used or been cancelled.
invalid_input.setup_token: The setup token was not accepted.
invalid_input.confirmation_required: Tick the confirmation before staging this document.
invalid_input.corporate_number: The corporate number is not valid.
invalid_input.code: Use letters and digits only for the code.
invalid_input.reference_code: Use letters, digits and hyphens only for the reference code.
invalid_input.target_month: The target month is not valid.
invalid_input.arrival_number: An arrival number does not match the configured pattern.
invalid_input.arrival_number_pattern: The pattern is not accepted. Use digits or simple character classes with a fixed length, for example [0-9]{17,18}.
invalid_input.jev_threshold: The threshold must be between 0.80 and 1.00.
invalid_input.model: Enter a fixed version such as jev-1.13.0. Aliases ending in -latest are not accepted.
invalid_input.credential: Enter your Jev API key in Settings first.
invalid_input.endpoint: This browser's notification service is not supported.
invalid_input.file_too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB.

invalid_state._: This cannot be done in the current state.
invalid_state.published_must_be_withdrawn: A published document must be withdrawn before it can be trashed.
invalid_state.case_not_cancellable: A case that already has a document cannot be cancelled.
invalid_state.not_cancellable: The office has already opened this file, so it can no longer be cancelled.
invalid_state.trash_expired: More than 30 days have passed, so this document can no longer be restored.
invalid_state.last_owner: The last Owner cannot be removed.
invalid_state.not_a_procedure: A submission date can only be recorded for procedure cases.
invalid_state.client_status_transition: This status change is not allowed.

classifier_failed._: The classifier could not be used. The documents stay unclassified.
classifier_failed.authentication_failed: The Jev API key was not accepted. The documents stay unclassified.
classifier_failed.unsupported_model: The model name is not supported. The documents stay unclassified.
classifier_failed.limit_reached: The usage limit of your Jev account was reached. The documents stay unclassified.
classifier_failed.network_failure: The classifier could not be reached. The documents stay unclassified.
classifier_failed.invalid_response: The classifier sent an answer that could not be used. The documents stay unclassified.

license.title: Licence
license.body: Komon Portal is open-source software released under the MIT License. Each office runs it in its own Cloudflare account.
license.thirdParty: It includes the following open-source software:

jev.title: Jev classifier (bring your own key)
jev.use: The portal can ask TypeSafe Jev to suggest the document type of a file. It is never used to decide which client a document belongs to.
jev.key: The key is your own. It is kept in your browser only, sent with a request when you start a classification, used for that one call and never stored on the server.
jev.sent: Only the form or notice name taken from the file name is sent, with arrival numbers, client codes and long digit runs removed. File contents are never sent.
jev.cost: Usage is billed to you by TypeSafe under their terms, including how they handle the data you send. Set your usage limit on their side. This portal shows no prices.
jev.models: Models and pricing on the TypeSafe site
jev.limits: Known limits of the Jev model

privacy.title: What the portal keeps about you
privacy.identity: Only your Google account ID and display name. Your email address, date of birth, address and phone number are not requested or stored.
privacy.cookies: One session cookie, needed to keep you signed in. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
privacy.individualNumber: Documents that contain an Individual Number (My Number) must not be uploaded.

ai.title: Use of AI
ai.body: Parts of this software and its interface texts were written with the help of AI and reviewed before release.
